registered: 2026-11-10, after VAL-8 (5-minute monitoring costs 0.11-0.17 Sharpe vs the hourly stop of the research), before any prop simulation on the 5-minute path was run
kind: risk design under the firm rules (not an alpha test); counts as 6 trials (stop grid)
question: Which daily-stop design gives the best prop outcome when the bot watches equity continuously, and how far are the published deployment numbers (H2 / H3, hourly stop) from the 5-minute reality?
path: 5-minute account path = the book's research hourly return (HyroTrader: results/v99/v99e_series.parquet; BrightFunded: results/v99/bf28_series.parquet; costs, funding, event sleeves included) with each hour's return distributed over its twelve 5-minute bars as: position-implied 5-minute P&L (CN-1 / CN-2 net positions x Binance 5-minute returns) + the hour's residual spread evenly; the hourly sums equal the research series exactly
simulator: qpl.hub.income.simulate unchanged (firm rule engine, 20-day block bootstrap 2022-01..2026-09, 400 paths, 3 challenge budget, 2 years, base scenario), series shifted to the planning Sharpe; daily (net, worst, best) built from the 5-minute path by the stop design

designs.reference: 2.5% on hourly closes of the hourly path (H2 / H3 as published)
designs.grid on the 5-minute path: stop at 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, 3.5, 4.0% of the account, checked on every 5-minute close (exit 0.1%)
designs.hybrid: 2.5% checked on the hour marks only + an emergency stop at 3.75% on every 5-minute close

decision: per firm: the design with the highest mean 2-year net at the planning Sharpe among those with P(net loss) <= 0.20; it replaces the 2.5% continuous stop only if its mean net is more than 3% above the 2.5% / 5-minute design at BOTH Sharpe levels; otherwise 2.5% stays. The planning tables (business plan) are restated with the 5-minute numbers of the chosen design.
